decision: Extract video frames with headless Edge over CDP instead of installing ffmpeg
why: No ffmpeg on the dev PC; Edge decodes HEVC through the GPU
evidence: 38 frames and 5 contact sheets from IMG_6899.MOV
result: Screen flow (zone home → detail → lightbox) and line style read from the footage

decision: Keep WAM's architecture: hub on the projector PC, touch PCs send selections
why: Email chain: WAM ran socket.io on the projector PC with one PC per screen
evidence: Map interactive email chain.pdf
result: server/hub.mjs with the ws package instead of socket.io (no client library needed)

decision: Split places across screens exactly as WAM did
why: WAM's CSS groups connector starts by kiosk; email says each kiosk covered the nearest area
evidence: Connector start points cluster at three edges (projector-all screenshot)
result: Screen 1: pyramid, waterbirds, concubines, size. Screen 2: army, acrobats, armour, horses. Screen 3: craftsmen, chariots, officials, animals

decision: Name zones Northern, Eastern, Western
why: Video shows "Explore the Northern Zone" for screen 1; minimaps are south-up, so screen 2 (army, armour) is east and screen 3 (chariots, graves) is west
evidence: Frame f_005.0; minimap orientation (bronze birds pit at the bottom)

decision: Drop "convicts"
why: SVGs exist but no text or images anywhere
evidence: Content agent report; OneDrive zip has 11 folders
result: 11 projected places plus the size card

decision: Rebuild line placement from WAM's style.css, including preserveAspectRatio meet letterboxing
why: Connector SVGs each have their own local canvas; only the CSS places them
evidence: Army start computed at (674,160), matching the agent's independent reading

decision: Place glows in each connector's own frame by fitting the glow outline to the connector's tail
why: WAM's CSS glow boxes use mask-size 42% and several lack a mask; glow files are hand-redrawn copies of the tail
evidence: Fit error ≤ 1.47 local units (< 1 stage px) for all 11
result: Glow always sits on its outline

decision: Unzip with Python zipfile, not Windows tar
why: Windows tar skipped the entry named 秦陵 (UTF-8 name without the zip UTF-8 flag)
evidence: tar.exe: "Archive entry has empty or unreadable filename"

decision: Assert imported text equals WAM's OneDrive Text.txt
why: Two sources should agree; a mismatch means a parsing error
evidence: --check passes; mutating one character in content.js makes --check fail
result: Content fidelity is a rerunnable gate

decision: Hub broadcasts full state snapshots, never deltas; touch screens re-announce with hello on reconnect
why: Any PC can restart at any time; snapshots converge
evidence: verify: hub restart restores the army line

decision: Only a touch hello tags a socket as a screen
why: Code review: calibration previews sent select messages from the projector socket, which would have tagged it as a screen and blocked the disconnect clear
evidence: Read-back of hub.mjs
result: Disconnect grace clears a dead touch PC's line (verify)

decision: Keystone as a CSS matrix3d homography plus per-screen anchor offsets with one elbow
why: NMA screen positions and projector throw will differ from WAM's
evidence: verify: saving anchor dx=60 moves the army line live and persists

decision: Start line animation with a forced reflow, not requestAnimationFrame
why: A page that is not painting never fires rAF but the timer still marked lines drawn
evidence: three-at-once screenshot showed only line start dots while the phase said drawn
result: verify now asserts computed stroke-dashoffset reaches 0

decision: Inactive views take no pointer events
why: A fading-out detail view sat above home for 350 ms and swallowed card taps
evidence: verify: horses and officials taps failed; TypeError in swipe handler

decision: Staff overlay needed an explicit [hidden] rule
why: display:grid overrode the hidden attribute and covered the whole screen
evidence: CDP tap landed on DIV, not the card

decision: Cinzel for headings, Source Sans 3 for body text
why: Cinzel has only capital letterforms; 60-word paragraphs in it read poorly
evidence: User asked for Cinzel; reversible by one CSS variable

decision: Home minimap stacks the zone's landmark minimaps
why: WAM's overview minimap carries a stray highlight; stacking lights all of the zone's places
evidence: touch-*-home screenshots

decision: Canberra overlay from OSM tiles plus WAM's site minimap, scaled by the outer wall (2165 m = 334 px), pyramid over Parliament House
why: User asked for a Canberra comparison; the minimap is a consistent-scale plan
evidence: E–W width 920 m vs 940 m; army 1.56 km east vs 1.5 km

decision: Mask the minimap's own compass rose and scale bar
why: They appeared rotated inside the map
evidence: First overlay render

decision: Chrome --kiosk; watchdog only relaunches and never restyles windows
why: squiggle v38: restyling raced Chrome's fullscreen exit and stranded a 0×0 window
evidence: V38-TRUE-KIOSK-MODE.md

decision: Add HKLM AllowEdgeSwipe, TouchGestureSetting=0, power, update, Chrome policies, firewall, logon task
why: v38 covered only HKCU touch keys and had no startup registration
evidence: TouchGestureSetting confirmed by Eleven Forum and Microsoft Q&A

decision: Hub readiness via raw TCP connect, not Invoke-WebRequest
why: Invoke-WebRequest to localhost stalled; Chrome never launched
evidence: Watchdog log stopped after "starting hub"
result: Watchdog run headless: start, kill Chrome and hub, both relaunched, projector reconnected

decision: stop_kiosk.bat kills only this install's Chrome profile
why: First draft ran taskkill /IM chrome.exe, which would close staff browsers
evidence: Read-back
result: Verified: stop left other processes running

decision: Each CDP page in its own window; bring to front before input
why: Background tabs in one headless window neither paint nor acknowledge input
evidence: Hung taps; false "drawn" pass
result: 26 checks, mutation tests turn them red

decision: Applied /simplify: dead code, one content loader, one touch-input helper, calibration listeners installed once, drag previews batched per frame; skipped a table for the single size card (n=1)
why: Four parallel reviewers (reuse, simplification, efficiency, altitude)
evidence: Reviewer reports

decision: Calibration handles read the projector view transform instead of #viewport size
why: New calibration check found every handle at (0,0): #viewport has zero size because its children are absolutely positioned
evidence: Handle positions all 0px,0px; drag hit an anchor instead of the corner
result: 27 checks pass; drag moves the corner by exactly (40,30)

decision: Remove the Workers' graves pit rectangle from the base map
why: NMA asked for a clean slate. WAM painted it in because the pit was missing from their 3D print (Sarah Dunbar, 22 Sep email)
evidence: Rectangle at (861,265)-(1024,320) matches the craftsmen glow outline
result: tools/clean-base-map.mjs writes content/map/base.png; delete it to restore WAM's original

decision: Support 1920x1080 and 1920x1200 on every PC
why: NMA hardware resolution; the projector previously shrank to 90% at 1080
evidence: verify checks both resolutions on the projector and all 12 touch pages
result: Map square fills the output height; keystone corners are the map corners

decision: Revert the projector sizing to fit WAM's whole 1920x1200 frame
why: NMA asked, to avoid any risk of stretching. At 1920x1080 the map now draws at 972 px (90%); scaling stays uniform
evidence: verify measures a square map at both resolutions
result: Keystone corners are the frame corners again; touch thumbnail fix kept

decision: Do not add the workers' graves pit to MausoleumMap.stl: it is already there
why: Blender ray casts: a 12 mm recess (same depth as every other pit), 390 x 116 mm, under WAM's painted rectangle; WAM's print predated it
evidence: Overlay of all 11 WAM outlines on a top-down render; Zhaobeihu convict cemetery is ~1.5 km west of the mound (model: 1.37 km)

decision: Shift the workers' graves line and glow 8.5 map px to sit on the STL pit
why: WAM's outline was 8.5 px (~20 mm on the table) north of the STL recess; all other outlines match
evidence: Outline 760-811 vs recess 769-819; after: 769-820
